_doc: #797 THE list of Phosphor icons Cloud Search draws (the owner's mockup uses Phosphor). phosphor2vd.py fetches each SVG of `version` from the npm package @phosphor-icons/core (MIT, see NOTICE.md) and writes it as res/drawable/ph_<name with - as _>.xml; test/test-search-shell.sh S9 holds this list, the drawables on disk and every R.drawable.ph_* the Kotlin names to one another. To add an icon: add it here and run `python3 app/tools/phosphor2vd.py`.

launcher._doc: #803 the app icon is the mockup's central bottom-nav icon: Phosphor `icon` filled with .ai-nav-icon's 135deg gradient (`gradient` names colors.xml entries, start to end; the mockup's rule declares no glow, only the gradient and its fallback colour). phosphor2vd.py writes res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml (the glyph at `size_dp`, centred in the 108dp adaptive canvas, inside the 66dp safe zone) and ic_launcher_monochrome.xml (the same glyph in one colour, for Android 13 themed icons) from the generated ph_<icon>.xml, so it needs no network: `python3 app/tools/phosphor2vd.py --launcher`. cloud-superapp's Cloud > Apps > AGI Search tile is a byte-identical copy of the foreground (aa_cloud-superapp/test/test-agi-tiles.sh T3).
